rules: Every ci_stage_order stage (kind stage) and every other ci-local.sh run label (kind trailing) is listed once. cost: light (no cargo build), build (compiles a cargo target), heavy (full suite or release build). Each entry carries exactly one of: ledger (ids of real failures it caught), provisionalUntil (date by which a real failure or a deterrent reason is due), deterrent (why the gate stays without a recorded failure). A gate that absorbed a former gate lists its id under absorbed: ledger rows keep the gate where the failure surfaced and the absorbing gate may cite them. Cite only real catches: a row recorded under a gate that was not at fault (an environment cause or a stale binary) stays in the ledger for history but is not cited as a catch. Record failures with ci-failure.sh --record.

gates.prevents: a size-budget breach, lossy path rendering, stale test-target, package or skill inventory or an in-band compatibility marker, stale release references, unreviewed public history, or a non-canonical commit identity reaching fmt/clippy/build or a push
a GitHub workflow that is invalid or unpinned reaching the default branch
gates.deterrent: workflow mistakes run with repository credentials before anyone reads them

gates.prevents: the workflow validator silently accepting a bad workflow
stage membership drifting between modes and platforms; a gate or historical reader missing from its inventory, on every platform
the quiet-command log wrapper losing exit codes or output
unformatted Rust reaching review
gates.deterrent: formatting drift makes every later diff noisy; costs seconds

gates.prevents: Rust lint findings reaching review
gates.deterrent: lint debt compounds across a 1.75-pinned toolchain

gates.prevents: a behaviour regression anywhere in the full test suite
a source file or module growing past its size or ownership budget
operator-private names or terms in tracked content, and a non-canonical commit identity in publication history
version, changelog and release metadata disagreeing
broken documentation links and stale documented claims
the first-run path for a new user regressing
the value report contract changing shape
plugin manifests and packaged plugin files disagreeing
a pre-return candidate breaking test targets its diff touches, or the binary's own unit tests when src/ or the manifest changed
the false-completion value proof no longer holding
gates.deterrent: the product's central claim; full mode only

gates.prevents: the drift-warning demo no longer warning
the real tmux child handoff losing bound evidence
the release binary failing to build
the release binary failing the onboarding smoke
a release archive with missing or extra files
gates.deterrent: the archive is what users install

gates.prevents: the installer failing to install the packaged archive
gates.deterrent: the installer is the documented install path
